topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Well, I heard that our Thomas, he went to see his old friend from when he was but a lad. He spoke of this friend for days, about how they’d play in the fields and steal apples from the orchard, even when the old man would chase them with a stick. But when Thomas met him, it turned out his friend had no memory of him. It was like all those days, all that laughing and running, it was just Thomas alone with the shadows. He didn’t say much after that, just walked back to his cottage, shoulders hunched like a cloud had followed him home. I don’t think he’ll be visiting again, not for a while, leastways.
